user.title: Changelog Traduction
user.description: Automatically translates and summarizes the release notes of available updates (HACS integrations, Supervisor add-ons, Home Assistant Core). Requires an AI Task integration (e.g. Google Generative AI) to already be installed and configured - without it, translation cannot work.

data.notify_service: Notification entities (pick one or more, e.g. your phone and your tablet)
data.ai_task_entity: AI Task entity used for translation (requires an AI integration already configured, e.g. Google Generative AI)
data.language: Target language (leave empty to use Home Assistant's own interface language)
data.use_persistent_notification: Create a persistent notification in Home Assistant

error.no_ai_task_entity: No AI Task entity found. Install and configure an AI integration first (e.g. Google Generative AI) that exposes an ai_task entity, then come back here.
